title: Comments
instructions: Comments are notes you leave in your code for humans. The computer ignores them completely — they never run.
Why bother? Because 'past you' forgets things, and 'future you' will thank you. Comments explain WHY code exists.
- // a single-line comment — everything after the two slashes, to the end of the line, is ignored.
- /* a block comment */ — everything between /* and */ is ignored, even across several lines.
The computer skips comments and only runs the real code.
task: Add a // comment above the printf, then make the program print:  Comments are just notes.
